name: Persistence Resources Group Ltd
summary: Persistence Resources Group Ltd, an investment holding company, engages in the exploration, mining, processing, and sale of gold bullion derived from gold concentrate in the People's Republic of China. It holds 75% interest in the Songjiagou Open-Pit Mine and the Songjiagou Underground Mine located in Songjiagou. Persistence Resources Group Ltd was formerly known as SINOGOLD Resources Holdings Group Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Persistence Resources Group Ltd in May 2022. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Sheung Wan, Hong Kong. Persistence Resources Group Ltd operates as a subsidiary of Majestic Gold Corp.
